statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-34069 (GHSA-2g68-c3qc-8985) affects only the interactive Werkzeug debugger. ReportAudit starts the service with app.run(..., debug=False) in app/servicio.py line 64, so the debugger is never enabled and the vulnerable code is not reachable. The dependency is still upgraded through the Dependabot security PR (part M).
